study: B3-C short-contact and feature increment audit
partial: Pearson correlation of average-rank residuals after projecting both ranked variables on intercept and ranked controls
residual: Semipartial Pearson coefficient of residualized feature ranks and original outcome ranks. Raw force residual versus outcome sensitivity uses Spearman.
splits: Shorter versus longer contact, fixed half split sorted on contact and edge ID. Five versus seven images. No split search.
near_contact_pairs: Disjoint adjacent pairs in the same contact ordering; preserve all contact gaps; orient within pair by tangent. Compare paired gain signs.
leave_one: Recompute ranks, control projections and correlations after each path deletion
rules: No regression prediction, new inference or DFT. Report all frozen specifications without p values or causal interpretation. Undefined if fewer than k+3 paths or rank deficiency for k controls.
